title: Summer Palace · Suzhou Street
limitations: The central market uses seven vector building records and the photographed three-arch crossing. The canal floor is reconstructed within the mapped channel. Shop counts and roof partitions beyond the mapped central reaches are approximate.

groundCutout.basis: Cap the coarse terrain only in the cropped, mapped channel or pond while its mapped footpaths remain usable.

waterCutout.basis: Use the local canal datum inside the mapped market channel and retain the native waterways outside it.
